title: AeroElast validation bibliography entry
description: One canonical, auditable reference. docs/validation/references.yaml is the rector; docs/references.md is generated from it. Field rules that need cross-file context (citation-key resolution, declared-vs-found citation diffing, .sources/ absence) are enforced by tools/validation_matrix.py 'check', not by this schema.

key.description: Stable join key. Matrix rows cite it via reference.citation; docs/references.md groups by it.

section.description: Bibliography section title, e.g. '1. Shell element formulations'. Replaces the old section-number pointer, which renumbering silently broke.

doi_status.description: verified and printed_on_pdf require a conforming doi, held: true and a non-empty verification_note. not_applicable covers report numbers, proprietary manuals and journals registering no DOI, and requires notes.

held_files.description: Paths under .sources/, which is gitignored: absence in a fresh clone is a warning, never a failure.

verification.description: The convention docs/references.md states in prose today.

verification_note.description: What exactly was read off the held copy: authors, title, journal, volume, year, printed DOI, page count.

cited_by_declared.description: The audited claim carried over from the current prose ('Cited by the code: file:line'). Diffed by check against cited_by_found.

orphan_ok.description: A reference neither cited by a matrix row nor present in cited_by_declared must set this with a reason in notes.
